name: Required textbooks for this semester
why: You need them to study and pass your courses.

name: Large milk tea with all the toppings every afternoon
why: A treat with friends, not something you need to live or study.

name: This month's rent & utilities
why: A fixed cost to keep a roof over your head.

name: Upgrading to the newest phone while yours still works
why: Your current phone already does the job. The upgrade is a wish.

name: Rice, eggs and vegetables for the week
why: Basic food keeps you healthy and able to study.

name: Concert ticket for your favourite band
why: Fun and memorable, but you can live without it.

name: Fuel to ride to class
why: You need transport to attend classes.

name: A third pair of trendy sneakers
why: You already have shoes. This one is about style.

name: Medicine when you are sick
why: Health comes first and can't wait.

name: New game skin during a sale
why: A discount doesn't turn a want into a need.

name: Internet plan for online classes
why: You need it to join classes and submit assignments.

name: Eating out at a buffet every weekend
why: Cooking at home is cheaper. Buffets are a treat.

name: Laptop for an IT major (you don't own one)
why: For some majors a basic laptop is a study tool. A top-end model would be a want.

name: A third streaming subscription
why: Entertainment is nice, but one service is plenty.

name: Soap, toothpaste and shampoo
why: Basic hygiene is part of everyday living.
